name: diagram-design
description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi. 44 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
one_liner: An add-on for AI coding assistants that draws clean, on-brand diagrams (flowcharts, architecture maps, and more) as a single file you can open in a browser, instead of the messy auto-generated charts most tools spit out.
buyer: A technical writer or dev-tools startup that currently pays a designer, or just lives with ugly auto-generated diagrams, to explain architecture or workflows in docs and pitch decks.
business_use_cases: A dev-tools startup generates consistent, branded architecture diagrams for its documentation site automatically from its own codebase.
A consulting firm turns client workshop notes into clean sequence or quadrant diagrams for a deliverable deck the same day.
An internal platform team documents system architecture diagrams that stay on-brand without hiring a designer.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'brand onboarding' service that configures the skill to match a company's exact visual style, then sell ongoing diagram-as-a-service for their docs.
Build and sell premium diagram-type packs beyond the default 44 for niche industries (legal process maps, supply chain, clinical workflows).

steal_this: A weekend 'docs makeover' service: take a startup's ugly architecture diagrams, redo all of them on-brand with this skill, and charge a flat fee per doc site.
